builder_notes: All three graphs use only 3D Voronoi / Noise textures on Object coordinates -> every texture has a 4D variant, so the D2 torus (seamless) mode needs no D5 substitution in this segment (class C).

Group socket defaults: when a socket is exposed by dragging to the Group Input, Blender copies the type, subtype, limits and description; the tutorial then changes Scale from Vector to Float and types default 1, and the group node's Scale must be set back to 1 (it reads 0 after the type change).

Socket lookup: the UI labels 'Factor' on Color Ramp / Noise / RGB Curves / HSV correspond to bpy socket name/identifier 'Fac' in older versions; look sockets up by identifier or index, not by display text (class C).
Bump node 'Filter Width' (0.1) exists in Blender 4.4+/5.x; set it explicitly.
Bump distances are in object units = metres here (0.002 / 0.004 / 0.00008 / 0.003 m).
Colour ramp grey for Cells stop 1: Perceptual V 0.659 / #A8A8A8 -> linear 0.3916 (sRGB EOTF).
